subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Data Advantage Nobody Shares
description: A quick, practical guide to The Data Advantage Nobody Shares.

hook.text: Netflix knows exactly what you watch, when you pause, what you skip, and what makes you cancel.

buildup.text: The Data Advantage Nobody Shares sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: The Data Advantage Nobody Shares reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Platforms refuse to share their viewership data publicly.

climax.text: Streaming's data advantage is also its most controversial tool.

punchline.text: They know everything about you. You know nothing about them.

quiz.question: Why is the lack of public viewership data controversial in streaming?
options: Creators negotiate contracts without being able to verify how their shows actually performed
